description: Use when an agent must know on which chains a wallet holds funds. Trigger: an address, optionally a chains subset. Outcome: balances, nonce and recent transfers on 12 EVM chains at once; chains that time out are marked. Price: $0.008 USDC per call (x402, Base).

address.description: wallet or contract address (0x + 40 hex chars) or ENS/Basename (vitalik.eth, name.base.eth)

chains.description: optional comma-separated subset, e.g. ethereum,base,bnb (default: all 12 chains)

name: multichain_wallet_report
title: Multichain wallet report: one address on 12 EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche ...) in one call
